name: Venomancer: Venoshroom mushrooms wear their model at 0.55 scale, cannot be attacked and Mycelial Ring grows 12 near the caster
contract: Mushroom summon 680764 creates creature 506018. Every live client creature-cache capture in AscensionDB
(2026-08-06 to 2026-09-10), the Exiles DB and the db.exil.es dump (2026-10-04) give it display 128263,
spells\Druid_Wild_Mushroom_03Hostile.M2 in both the server and client CreatureDisplayInfo/CreatureModelData,
shipped in the client's patch-N.MPQ. The previous template used 26981, the invisible stalker.
The template keeps its 0.55 display scale, which matches the small mushrooms in live footage of the ring.
Mycelial Ring 681056's tooltip in the installed client: "immediately grows 12 Mushrooms in a circle around you".
Live footage shows them scattered close around the caster, well inside the 8 yd ring: the Mushroom summon
680764 places its creature at a random point within radius index 26 (4 yd), so no Mushroom grows beyond 4.5 yd.
Each Mushroom explodes after 2 sec, so all twelve still stand 1.5 sec after the cast and are gone 4 sec later.
Spore 572869 drops one Mushroom below its target after 10 sec, which must also wear display 128263.
Mushrooms are an untargetable effect of the Venomancer's spells: no hostile unit may attack them.
